inspectionCoverage.method: Viewed every packet preview directly, including all logical background views, enlarged RGB/alpha W/S and combined strips, all difference maps and alpha sheets. The 24 native/independent full join images were inspected through preview cells whose pixels I reproduced and checked. Independently reproduced all 12 assemblies from unchanged native corner and approved straight RGBA frames; compared complete RGBA bytes. Raw and atlas PNG hashes are identical by facing.

scoreExplanation.shapeVolume: Compared with the original sharp uniform extrusion, the rounded outer coping turn, shallow crown and wood relief give a coherent substantial bend. The inside miter reads as a designed bevel transition rather than a broad diagonal shading scar.
scoreExplanation.color: Honey wood remains warm and readable to the base, with clean blue separation. The native palette is less luminous than ImageGen but coherent with the exact approved straight family.
scoreExplanation.lightingHighlights: Broad colored highlights reveal the cap and soften exposed edges without white burn. All required rotations remain similarly lit and have no ground shadow or black dead patch.
scoreExplanation.materialDetail: Broad wood grain and course relief survive logical-size viewing. The cap has soft form shading rather than the source flat dead area. Grain is more regular and the finish more matte than the target.
scoreExplanation.artifactFreeReadability: All facings and both-port/combined assemblies remain clean and legible on light, gray and dark backgrounds. No material RGB seam, alpha gap, clipping, broken corner or muddy merged form remains.

observations.finding: The useful native construction changes improve the outside bend and panel volume while preserving the source outward W/S L role. N/W show a softly rounded lower outside corner; E/S show the same cap turning above the narrow functional leg. None of the four views contains a pinched turn, a detached masking post or a broad accidental diagonal scar.

Warm honey grain and shallow relief replace the original blank brown panels; lower wood no longer becomes a dark dead area. Blue remains distinct from the wood cap/undercut. The long assembled cap is continuous and has enough soft variation to read as volume at game scale.

Soft broad highlights and colored gradients retain the blue and wood surfaces. The inside miters retain localized geometric bevel changes without a black patch. Fine render grain appears enlarged but does not sparkle or distract at logical size.

All local W and S paired joins and combined three-module L joins remain continuous in both the native context and unchanged independent sprite assembly. Cap highlights, wood bands and coverage align; no dark cut line, transparent slit or doubled edge is visible at logical scale.

observations.evidence: All 16 enlarged RGB/alpha join strips, 12 RGB difference maps, four combined alpha sheets and both four-view alpha sheets were directly inspected.
observations.finding: Enlargement confirms clean silhouettes and filled joins. Native and independent results are not byte-identical: difference maps expose small stochastic/antialiasing and slender-band differences. These do not produce a material visible seam in the actual RGB or alpha review surfaces.

remainingDifferences: The native blue is softer and more matte, with broader lower-contrast highlights than ImageGen; it does not reproduce the target bright white/cyan rim.
Native wood grain is broader and more regular than the target flowing hand-drawn pattern. It remains restrained and readable in the approved modular family.

Open terminal cuts retain the exact source cross-section and square contact planes instead of the target rounded standalone ends. The narrow cut face visible in unconnected E/S sprites is functional and matches the family.
Fine Cycles sampling grain and small independent-versus-native antialiasing/irradiance differences are visible enlarged; no material defect remains at intended size.

profilesAndMaterials.coordinateMapping: Native family_coordinate attribute replaces straight Object coordinates around the bend; terminal coordinates and family shader parameters are retained.
profilesAndMaterials.lighting: Approved five-light/world configuration present in the reopened source; centered overhead and four equal cardinal fills. No ground receiver, no per-facing material/light configuration.
